stemMd: Convert 72 kilometres per hour to metres per second.
explanationMd: Multiply by 1000 metres per kilometre and divide by 3600 seconds per hour. Thus $72/3.6=20$.

distractorRationale.c: Multiplies by 0.36 instead of dividing by 3.6.
distractorRationale.d: Loses a factor of ten in time conversion.
distractorRationale.a: Introduces an extra factor of ten in the denominator.
